answer: In this PoA design, each bonded identity remains an independently accountable escrow, so dividing control among sybils does not dilute risk: when k coordinated identities equivocate, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2) through pairwise correlated-fault charges. Upon detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier applies to the swarm, rapidly consuming collateral and depreciating its remaining value; labels such as ivory, opal, or pigment do not alter the evidence rules.
